name: Alarm and relay status
interpretation: 16-bit field; bits 0 through 7 are relay states; bits 8 through 15 are alarm states

name: Digital I/O status
interpretation: 16-bit field; bits 0 through 7 are outputs; bits 8 through 15 are inputs

name: PV or rate integer
interpretation: Signed 32-bit integer excluding the configured decimal point
